body:
Opus2 integration plan for the ONE-SHOT include! -> mod migration. Greg's proposal came via Asistant #76 and #2484; Fable2 ruled in #7481, #7483 and #7484.

Candidate:
- ONE candidate, cut by Termal::Fable52 (19461) on BASE bd01930c155bd15641a6615b37bd87215db02444 (S0's reviewed commit, whose parent is master 487cb4e4). The ff carries S0 plus the migration.
- It replaces B1..B11. Pilot b15dcd57 (w-e50841447cd8), B2 e8cfd21b (w-fa8265af62a7) and B3 (w-6bc9f4390e7f) are superseded as landings; their reviews stay as evidence.
- The 11 hand units are in, each listed with what was changed by hand. Anything beyond move, visibility and wiring stays an include!.
- Units whose module path is observable stay include!: module_path!() (coordination_persist.rs:1121), std::any::type_name (remote_routes.rs:588), and tracing default targets.
- Diagnostic stderr changes are OK if listed. Nothing stored, sent on a wire, matched by a filter or asserted by a test may change.

Gates, per iteration:
- One compile leg each on DL560 (fmt, cargo check, test --no-run, warnings equal to baseline 10/32, tool tests, verify) and Windows B.
- Then both FULLs in parallel: DL560 from a test ref, and Windows B hostless plain with GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL ABSENT and a short TERMAL_TEST_USER_TEMP.
- Windows B has a one-repeat rule for environment crashes only.
- macOS cargo check only if macOS-conditional code moves.

FREEZE: no other TermAl src landing from Fable52's cut report until the migration lands.

LANDING: NO review pair, so it is outside the standing rule. It lands ONLY on Greg's OWN word typed in Opus2's session. Never on a relay from Fable2, Asistant or anyone else.

S0's Central credit legs (w-6296 focused 7 names, w-ba1a nofile_ 26) are needed only to CLOSE w-6296 and w-ba1a, not to land. S0's gates: FULL test-5db67132 (DL560) and Windows test-aef36eb2 (Windows B), both PASS and equal to source_id c519c86b.
